label: Reset synchronizers
subgoals: Name recovery and removal as reset-pin timing checks
Tie the first flop's input to the inactive level
Assert asynchronously and release synchronously in each clock domain

label: Reset-domain crossings
subgoals: Identify flops whose reset differs from their source's reset
Explain how an asynchronous source reset can corrupt a running destination
Isolate the destination or order the resets

label: Verifying reset behavior
subgoals: Run reset sequences in four-state simulation to expose uninitialized flops
Assert the required order of reset releases between domains
Test soft resets of one block while other traffic runs
